title: keybindings.json
description: Jisuno keybindings: an object with the schema reference and the binding list. Hot-reloaded; on error the file is rejected and the last good config stays live.

$schema.description: Path of this schema as written under ~/.config/jisuno/schemas/.

bindings.description: Every key binding. Two bindings with the same key and the same when are a duplicate and rejected.

key.description: Lowercase, +-joined: modifiers first in ctrl+option+shift+cmd order, then the key (e.g. ctrl+option+w). Side-specific hold keys: right_option, right_cmd, right_shift, right_ctrl. Anything uppercase is rejected; write ctrl+option+w, not Ctrl+Option+W.

hold.description: When true the key is a hold key: key-down opens the mic, key-up ends the utterance and transcribes. Only a single right-side modifier (right_option, right_cmd, right_shift, right_ctrl) may be a hold key, one key alone, and it counts only if no other key is pressed during it.

when.description: Context the binding lives in; absent means global. listening: a hold utterance or hands-free session is recording. confirming: a command with confirm:true is showing its HUD prompt.

command.description: Bindable commands: voice.dictate (hold to dictate; release inserts the text), voice.command (hold to speak a command phrase; release runs it), voice.cancel (cancel the current utterance or pending confirm), voice.confirm (run the pending confirmed command), voice.hands_free_toggle (start/stop hands-free dictation), model.warm (load the model ahead of time), model.unload (unload the model now; no default key), jisuno.settings (open Settings), jisuno.menu (open the menu bar popover; no default key).
